note: Triennial election, polled at the end of May 1939. There was no contest; the list of returned members leaves the council 18 Unionists and 12 Nationalists. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Corrected from the page image of Northern Whig, 4 May 1939, p. 10 (council-audit, Nov 2026): the round note no longer says Lisnaskea returned two members; it returned one, and John W. M'Vitty sat for Magheraveely. Renamed from 'Roslea' to Rosslea (19 Nov 2026, w19-merges, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official DED name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the 1911 DED map (Clones No. 2 Rural District) and the NI DED maps of 1921-39 name the DED Rosslea, as the rounds of 1924, 1930, 1933 and 1964 are filed. This round was filed as 'Roslea', the spelling of its source, kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (roslea) answers with a redirect to this one.
